   300	      ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
   301	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 0 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 1 =
   302	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u r + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u t
   303	    ring
   304	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 1 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 0 =
   305	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u t + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u r

     3	/-!
     4	# Ordered products selected by a global projective measurement
     5	
     6	The point comparison of a projective measurement can be refined to its original
     7	outcomes and composed with the two combined-point ordered-product estimates.
     8	All bounds are on the actual expanded state and retain the complete outcome sum.
     9	
    10	## References
    11	
    12	`eq:qld-g-42` and `eq:qld-g-43`, paper
    13	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1283-1300`.
    14	These are auxiliary estimates for issue #513, not the global-pair constructor.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    20	
    21	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    22	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    23	
    24	noncomputable section
    25	
    26	/-- Projective refinement followed by two operator comparisons. If the evaluated
    27	measurement has consistency defect at most `eta` with `B`, and `B` is within
    28	`deltaSelf` of `A`, which is within `deltaOrder` of `T`, the full outcome sum
    29	for `R - R T` is at most `4 eta + 4 deltaSelf + 4 deltaOrder`.
    30	This is the quantitative insertion calculation in `eq:qld-g-42/43`; `T` need
    31	not be a measurement, so it applies to either ordered product. -/
    32	theorem projective_refinement_ordered_dist_le {X Γ α ι : Type*}
    33	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    34	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    35	    (μ : Distribution X) (R : Measurement Γ ι) (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R)
    36	    (ev : X → Γ → α) (A B : X → Measurement α ι) (T : X → α → Op ι)
    37	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (eta deltaSelf deltaOrder : ℝ)
    38	    (hpoint : consistencyDefect μ
    39	      (fun x a => (R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a) (fun x a => (B x).effect a) ψ ≤ eta)
    40	    (hself : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    41	      (fun x a => (A x).effect a) ψ ≤ deltaSelf)
    42	    (horder : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a) T ψ ≤ deltaOrder) :
    43	    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    44	      (fun x g => R.effect g * T x (ev x g)) ψ ≤
    45	        4 * eta + 4 * deltaSelf + 4 * deltaOrder := by
    46	  have hlift (U V : X → α → Op ι) :
    47	      opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x g => R.effect g * U x (ev x g))
    48	        (fun x g => R.effect g * V x (ev x g)) ψ ≤ opFamilyDistSq μ U V ψ := by
    49	    unfold opFamilyDistSq
    50	    apply avgOver_mono
    51	    intro x
    52	    simpa only [mul_sub] using sum_norm_mul_funIndexed_apply_le (ev x) R.effect
    53	      (fun a => U x a - V x a) ψ (measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one R)
    54	  have hinsert : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    55	      (fun x g => R.effect g * (B x).effect (ev x g)) ψ ≤ 2 * eta := by
    56	    have h := hlift (fun x a => (R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a)
    57	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    58	    simp only [effect_mul_postprocess_effect_self R hR] at h
    59	    exact h.trans ((opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect μ
    60	      (fun x => R.postprocess (ev x)) B ψ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint
    61	        (by norm_num)))
    62	  have htail := (hlift (fun x a => (B x).effect a) T).trans
    63	    (opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    64	      (fun x a => (A x).effect a) T ψ deltaSelf deltaOrder hself horder)
    65	  have h := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    66	    (fun x g => R.effect g * (B x).effect (ev x g))
    67	    (fun x g => R.effect g * T x (ev x g)) ψ (2 * eta)
    68	    (2 * deltaSelf + 2 * deltaOrder) hinsert htail
    69	  convert h using 1
    70	  ring
    71	
    72	namespace CombinedPointsWitness
    73	
    74	/-- Both ordered estimates `eq:qld-g-42/43` for a projective global measurement
    75	on any expanded block, compared to point operators on its opposite block.
    76	The readout `ev` may in particular be evaluation of an extended polynomial.
    77	The input `eta` is the actual rounded point-comparison error, not the unrounded
    78	low-degree error. The two losses of `deltaQ` come respectively from point
    79	self-consistency and the existing ordered-product approximation. No global-pair
    80	witness or concentration estimate is assumed. -/
    81	theorem ordered_dist_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ}
    82	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
    83	    {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    84	    (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    85	    (R : Measurement Γ (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    86	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (ev : ExtendedPointQuestion P → Γ → PauliScalar P)
    87	    (eta : ℝ)
    88	    (hpoint : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
    89	      (fun x a => S.place p1 ((R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a))
    90	      (fun x a => S.place p2
    91	        ((points.extendedQ p2.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤ eta) :
    92	    (opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
    93	      (fun _ g => S.place p1 (R.effect g))
    94	      (fun x g => S.place p1 (R.effect g) * S.place p2
    95	        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
    96	            x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = ev x g),
    97	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1 *
    98	            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2)) S.psiHat ≤
    99	        4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧
   100	    (opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   101	      (fun _ g => S.place p1 (R.effect g))
   102	      (fun x g => S.place p1 (R.effect g) * S.place p2
   103	        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
   104	            x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = ev x g),
   105	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2 *
   106	            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat ≤
   107	        4 * eta + 8 * δQ) := by
   108	  classical
   109	  let A (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) := S.placedMeasurement p1
   110	    (points.extendedQ p1.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2)
   111	  let B (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) := S.placedMeasurement p2
   112	    (points.extendedQ p2.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2)
   113	  have hpoint' : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   114	      (fun x a => ((S.placedMeasurement p1 R).postprocess (ev x)).effect a)
   115	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ eta := by
   116	    simpa only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   117	      ProjectiveSetting.place_finsetSum, B] using hpoint
   118	  have hself : opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   119	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a) (fun x a => (A x).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ δQ := by
   120	    rw [opFamilyDistSq_symm]
   121	    exact (extendedQ_spec points).2.1 p1 p2 hopposite
   122	  have hbound := projective_refinement_ordered_dist_le
   123	    (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P)) (S.placedMeasurement p1 R)
   124	    (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR) ev A B
   125	  constructor
   126	  · have h := hbound _ S.psiHat eta δQ δQ hpoint' hself
   127	      ((extendedQ_spec points).2.2.1 p1 p2 hopposite)
   128	    simpa only [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   129	      show 4 * eta + 4 * δQ + 4 * δQ = 4 * eta + 8 * δQ by ring] using h
   130	  · have h := hbound _ S.psiHat eta δQ δQ hpoint' hself
   131	      ((extendedQ_spec points).2.2.2 p1 p2 hopposite)
   132	    simpa only [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   133	      show 4 * eta + 4 * δQ + 4 * δQ = 4 * eta + 8 * δQ by ring] using h
   134	
   135	end CombinedPointsWitness

     4	/-!
     5	# Restricting and completing global polynomial-pair measurements
     6	
     7	The combining map embeds pairs of bounded individual-degree polynomials into
     8	extended polynomials. Restricting a measurement along this embedding produces a
     9	submeasurement whose missing operator is the sum of the noncombined effects.
    10	Relabeling those effects by one specified pair completes the measurement and
    11	preserves projectivity.
    12	
    13	These algebraic constructions do not establish the concentration estimate
    14	`eq:qld-g-non-separable` or the point consistency required by
    15	`exists_globalPairWitness`; those are separate quantitative obligations.
    16	
    17	## References
    18	
    19	- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    20	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1375-1404`,
    21	  `eq:qld-sgg-completeness` and the final completion paragraph.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder
    27	
    28	noncomputable section
    29	
    30	/-- Recover the two polynomial components by setting the unused block to zero
    31	and the scalar coordinates to `(1,0)` or `(0,1)`. This algebraic substitution
    32	is the left inverse implicit in the restriction to combined outcomes in
    33	`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Unlike evaluation as a
    34	polynomial function on a finite field, it does not require a degree bound. -/
    35	noncomputable def recoverCombinedPair {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    36	    (polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * m + 2)) K) :
    37	    MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K :=
    38	  (MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    39	    match finCombineEquiv m index with
    40	    | .inl (.inl coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    41	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
    42	    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 0 then 1 else 0) polynomial,
    43	   MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    44	    match finCombineEquiv m index with
    45	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
    46	    | .inl (.inr coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    47	    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 1 then 1 else 0) polynomial)
    48	
    49	/-- Substitution recovers both components of a combined polynomial. This is
    50	formalization support for the relabeling in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper
    51	lines 1375--1380. -/
    52	@[simp] theorem recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    53	    (first second : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) :
    54	    recoverCombinedPair (combinePoly first second) = (first, second) := by
    55	  simp [recoverCombinedPair, combinePoly, MvPolynomial.eval₂_rename,
    56	    embX, embZ, alphaVar, betaVar, Function.comp_def, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eta]
    57	
    58	/-- Distinct polynomial pairs label distinct combined outcomes. This justifies
    59	restricting a measurement on extended polynomials to pairs without duplicating
    60	an effect in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
    61	theorem combinePoly_injective {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ} :
    62	    Function.Injective (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
    63	      combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) := by
    64	  exact (show Function.LeftInverse recoverCombinedPair
    65	    (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
    66	      combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) from fun pair =>
    67	        recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly pair.1 pair.2).injective
    68	
    69	/-- The bounded polynomial-pair embedding used to restrict the global
    70	measurement in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. The degree
    71	bound is inherited from `def:combine-map`; the two scalar coordinates have
    72	degree one, allowed by admissibility. -/
    73	noncomputable def combinedPolyEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    74	    PolyPair P ↪ MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d where
    75	  toFun pair := ⟨combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1,
    76	    combinePoly_mem_polyFunc P.hd pair.1.2 pair.2.2⟩
    77	  inj' := by
    78	    intro first second heq
    79	    have hpoly : combinePoly first.1.1 first.2.1 = combinePoly second.1.1 second.2.1 :=
    80	      congrArg Subtype.val heq
    81	    have hpair : (first.1.1, first.2.1) = (second.1.1, second.2.1) :=
    82	      combinePoly_injective hpoly
    83	    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hpair))
    84	      (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd hpair))
    85	
    86	/-- Evaluation of a combined outcome is the affine combination of its two
    87	components.  This is the pointwise algebraic identity used when transferring
    88	the global-pair measurement to the expanded point measurements in
    89	`lem:qld-4-7`, paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1364--1380`.
    90	It is a formalization-only consequence of `def:combine-map`; it does not assert
    91	any consistency or quantitative error estimate.
    92	-/
    93	theorem combinedPolyEmbedding_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
    94	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → PauliScalar P) (pair : PolyPair P) :
    95	    MvPolynomial.eval u (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair).1 =
    96	      u (alphaVar P.m) * evalAt .X (projX u) pair +
    97	        u (betaVar P.m) * evalAt .Z (projZ u) pair := by
    98	  change MvPolynomial.eval u (combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1) = _
    99	  rw [combinePoly_eval]
   100	  rfl
   101	
   102	/-- Restrict an extended-polynomial measurement to combined outcomes, as in
   103	`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Injectivity of the combining
   104	map ensures that the retained effects sum to at most the identity. This
   105	construction does not assert the source's quantitative completeness bound. -/
   106	noncomputable def combinedPairSubmeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   107	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   108	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   109	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier) :
   110	    Quantum.Submeasurement (PolyPair P) carrier where
   111	  effect pair := measurement.effect (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
   112	  pos pair := measurement.pos _
   113	  sum_le_one := by
   114	    classical
   115	    rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   116	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   117	    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
   118	      (fun outcome _ _ => measurement.pos outcome)).trans measurement.sum_le_one
   119	
   120	/-- Restricting to combined outcomes preserves projectivity, as asserted
   121	before `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
   122	theorem combinedPairSubmeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams)
   123	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   124	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   125	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   126	    (hprojective : Measurement.IsProjective measurement) :
   127	    ∀ pair, Quantum.IsProj ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair) := by
   128	  intro pair
   129	  exact hprojective (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
   130	
   131	/-- The missing operator of the polynomial-pair submeasurement is exactly the
   132	sum of the effects outside the range of the combining map. This is the
   133	operator identity underlying `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380;
   134	the bound on its state mass is a separate obligation. -/
   135	theorem combinedPairSubmeasurement_missing (P : AdmissibleParams)
   136	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   137	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   138	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier) :
   139	    1 - (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total =
   140	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   141	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   142	        measurement.effect polynomial := by
   143	  classical
   144	  have htotal : (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total =
   145	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   146	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   147	        measurement.effect polynomial := by
   148	    change (∑ pair, measurement.effect (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)) = _
   149	    rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   150	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   151	    congr 1
   152	    ext polynomial
   153	    simp
   154	  rw [htotal, ← measurement.sum_eq_one]
   155	  apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr
   156	  exact (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
   157	    (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P))
   158	    measurement.effect).symm.trans (add_comm _ _)
   159	
   160	/-- Relabel a combined polynomial by its unique pair and send every other
   161	polynomial to a specified pair. This implements the completion at an arbitrary
   162	outcome in the last paragraph of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404. The
   163	noncombined outcomes are retained at the completion outcome, not discarded. -/
   164	noncomputable def completedPairLabel (P : AdmissibleParams) (completionPair : PolyPair P) :
   165	    MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d → PolyPair P :=
   166	  Function.extend (combinedPolyEmbedding P) id (fun _ => completionPair)
   167	
   168	/-- Completion preserves every combined polynomial's pair label. -/
   169	@[simp] theorem completedPairLabel_combinedPolyEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams)
   170	    (completionPair pair : PolyPair P) :
   171	    completedPairLabel P completionPair (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair) = pair := by
   172	  exact (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective.extend_apply _ _ _
   173	
   174	/-- All outcomes outside the combining map's range go to the completion pair. -/
   175	theorem completedPairLabel_of_not_mem_range (P : AdmissibleParams)
   176	    (completionPair : PolyPair P)
   177	    (polynomial : MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d)
   178	    (houtside : polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)) :
   179	    completedPairLabel P completionPair polynomial = completionPair := by
   180	  exact Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ houtside
   181	
   182	/-- The completed polynomial-pair measurement of the final paragraph of
   183	`lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, obtained by relabeling all extended
   184	polynomial outcomes. No assertion about consistency is built into this
   185	construction. -/
   186	noncomputable def completedPairMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   187	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   188	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   189	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   190	    (completionPair : PolyPair P) : Quantum.Measurement (PolyPair P) carrier :=
   191	  measurement.postprocess (completedPairLabel P completionPair)
   192	
   193	/-- Completing the pair measurement adds precisely its missing operator to
   194	the specified outcome and leaves all other effects unchanged. This is the
   195	completion formula of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404. -/
   196	theorem completedPairMeasurement_effect (P : AdmissibleParams)
   197	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   198	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   199	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   200	    (completionPair pair : PolyPair P) :
   201	    (completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair).effect pair =
   202	      (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair +
   203	        if pair = completionPair then 1 - (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total
   204	        else 0 := by
   205	  classical
   206	  rw [completedPairMeasurement, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   207	  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
   208	    (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P))]
   209	  have hgood :
   210	      Finset.univ.filter (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)) =
   211	        Finset.univ.image (combinedPolyEmbedding P) := by
   212	    ext polynomial
   213	    simp
   214	  rw [hgood, Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   215	    (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   216	  simp only [completedPairLabel_combinedPolyEmbedding]
   217	  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ pair)]
   218	  congr 1
   219	  have hbad :
   220	      (∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   221	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   222	        if completedPairLabel P completionPair polynomial = pair then
   223	          measurement.effect polynomial else 0) =
   224	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   225	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   226	        if completionPair = pair then measurement.effect polynomial else 0 := by
   227	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   228	    intro polynomial hpolynomial
   229	    rw [completedPairLabel_of_not_mem_range P completionPair polynomial
   230	      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpolynomial).2]
   231	  rw [hbad]
   232	  by_cases heq : pair = completionPair
   233	  · simp [heq, combinedPairSubmeasurement_missing]
   234	  · simp [heq, Ne.symm heq]
   235	
   236	/-- The completed polynomial-pair measurement is projective whenever the
   237	extended-polynomial measurement is projective. This proves the qualitative
   238	completion step in `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, without assuming its
   239	unproved consistency conclusion. -/
   240	theorem completedPairMeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams)
   241	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   242	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   243	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   244	    (hprojective : Measurement.IsProjective measurement) (completionPair : PolyPair P) :
   245	    Measurement.IsProjective (completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair) := by
   246	  exact SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective measurement hprojective _
   247	
   248	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
   249	
   250	/-- Completion can only increase agreement with any evaluated reference
   251	measurement on the opposite tensor factor. Consequently, its consistency
   252	defect is at most the squared state norm minus the retained diagonal overlap.
   253	This is the completion step of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, for an

+/-- Coordinate transport of arbitrary placed operator families through a
+specified opposite bipartition. The two identities are representation data,
+constructed for every opposite pair by `exists_opposite_bipartition`; no
+mathematical approximation or extra assumption on the strategy is introduced. -/
+theorem ProjectiveSetting.consistencyDefect_bipartition {params : AdmissibleParams}
+    {error : ℝ} (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)
+    (equivalence : SixReg params setting.toStrategy.ιA setting.toStrategy.ιB ≃
+      setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side ×
+        (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side × (PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params)))
+    (hfirst : ∀ operator : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side),
+      reindexOp equivalence (heteroKron operator 1) = setting.place first operator)
+    (hsecond : ∀ operator : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side),
+      reindexOp equivalence (heteroKron 1 (heteroKron operator
+        (1 : Op (PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params)))) =
+        setting.place second operator)
+    {question answer : Type*} [Fintype question] [DecidableEq question]
+    [Fintype answer] [DecidableEq answer] (law : Distribution question)
+    (firstFamily : question → answer → Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
+    (secondFamily : question → answer → Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :

+      (reindexState equivalence setting.psiHat) =
+    consistencyDefect law (fun query output => setting.place first (firstFamily query output))
+      (fun query output => setting.place second (secondFamily query output)) setting.psiHat := by

+  congr 1
+  funext query
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro output _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro other _
+  split_ifs
+  · rfl
+  · rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm,
+      WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,

+/-- An unused tensor factor commutes with both the ordered sandwich and its
+evaluation. This identity keeps the unused EPR pair when applying the
+heterogeneous pasting theorem to the expanded state. -/
+theorem evaluated_pastedMeasurement_heteroKron_one
+    {firstAnswer secondAnswer result carrier unused : Type*}
+    [Fintype firstAnswer] [Fintype secondAnswer] [DecidableEq result]
+    [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier] [Fintype unused] [DecidableEq unused]
+    (first : firstAnswer → Op carrier) (second : secondAnswer → Op carrier)
+    (evaluate : firstAnswer → secondAnswer → result) (output : result) :
+    (∑ firstAnswer, ∑ secondAnswer, if evaluate firstAnswer secondAnswer = output then
+      pastedMeasurement (fun answer => heteroKron (first answer) (1 : Op unused))
+        (fun answer => heteroKron (second answer) (1 : Op unused)) firstAnswer secondAnswer
+      else 0) =
+    heteroKron (∑ firstAnswer, ∑ secondAnswer,
+      if evaluate firstAnswer secondAnswer = output then
+        pastedMeasurement first second firstAnswer secondAnswer else 0) (1 : Op unused) := by
+  simp only [pastedMeasurement, heteroKron_mul, mul_one]
+  ext row column
+  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.ite_apply,
+    Finset.sum_mul, ite_mul]

+This formalization identity is valid without an injectivity assumption on the
+evaluation functions, including completed evaluation at a degenerate line. -/

+    [Fintype answer] [DecidableEq answer] [Fintype first] [DecidableEq first]
+    [Fintype second] [DecidableEq second] [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]

+    (measurement.postprocess (fun answer => (evaluate answer).swap)).effect output =
+      (measurement.postprocess evaluate).effect output.swap := by
+  simp only [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
+  congr 1
+  ext answer
+  simp [Prod.ext_iff, and_comm]

+    {Question Outcome : Type*} [Fintype Question] [DecidableEq Question]
+    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
+    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)
+    (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second) (distribution : Distribution Question)
+    (left : Question → Quantum.Measurement Outcome (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))

+      (fun question answer => setting.place second ((right question).effect answer))
+      (fun question answer => setting.place first ((left question).effect answer))
+      setting.psiHat := by
+  unfold consistencyDefect
+  congr 1
+  funext question
+  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro answer _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro other _
+  rw [setting.place_comm first second hopposite]
+  simp only [eq_comm]

+constructed in the proof of `lem:qld-xz-lines`, paper

+          (fun sample answer => S.place p1
+            (((S.combinedLineMeasurement p1.side sample.1.1 sample.2.1).postprocess
+              fun fs => (evalOpt sample.1.1 sample.1.2 fs.1,
+                evalOpt sample.2.1 sample.2.2 fs.2)).effect answer))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p2

+              (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect answer))
+          S.psiHat ≤ deltaP ε (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)) := by

+      (params.m * params.d : ℕ) / (params.q : ℝ) := by
+    calc

+      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmd hq.le
+  have hunit : consistencyDefect
+      (Distribution.prod (linePointDist params.toLdParams) (linePointDist params.toLdParams))

+/-- Under the unchanged diagonal line-point law, zero projected directions have
+probability at most the inverse field size: the final unprojected direction coordinate must
+vanish and is uniform. Source: `def:line-point-dist`, paper
+`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. This proof-only bound
+supports the collision restriction used in the paired-line construction. -/
+theorem dLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass_le (L : LdParams) :
+    avgOver (dLinePointDist L) (fun sample =>
+      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
+      1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
+  classical
+  let last : Fin L.m := ⟨L.m - 1, by have := L.hm; omega⟩
+  let coord : LdIndex L := .inr last
+  have hmap : (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map (fun raw => raw coord) =
+      uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L) := by
+    change (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
+      (fun raw => (Equiv.funSplitAt coord (ScalarQ L) raw).1) = _
+    rw [← Distribution.map_map, uniformDistribution_map_equiv,
+      uniformDistribution_map_fst]
+  have hzero : avgOver (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
+      (fun raw => if raw coord = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
+      1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
+    rw [← Distribution.avgOver_map (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
+      (fun raw => raw coord) (fun value => if value = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0), hmap]
+    simp [avgOver, uniformDistribution_weight_apply, mul_ite]
+  unfold dLinePointDist clDistribution

+/-!
+# Square roots of the Pauli soundness error
+
+The state-extraction estimate bounds a squared norm. Taking its square root
+preserves the Pauli soundness error family after halving the exponent.
+
+## References
+
+Recovered from the verified issue #529 object at
+`a7a52e4c0d7bad95d471036accedd33b358694fb`,
+`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Soundness/ErrorBounds.lean`, for issue #513.
+
+Blueprint `rem:pauli-robustness-form`; the source states the squared bound at
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1868-1876`,
+whereas `thm:pauli` bounds the unsquared norm.
+-/
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+/-- Taking the square root of the Pauli error is bounded by halving its
+exponent. This formalization-only scalar estimate supports the passage from
+the squared extraction bound to the norm bound in blueprint
+`rem:pauli-robustness-form`; it is stated as `thm:pauli-error-square-root-support`.
+It holds for all nonnegative errors. -/
+theorem sqrt_deltaQld_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {a b epsilon : ℝ}
+    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) :
+    Real.sqrt (deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ≤
+      deltaQld a (b / 2) epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+  let degree : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ)
+  have hdegree : 1 ≤ degree :=
+    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)
+  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := zero_le_one.trans ha
+  have hdegree0 : 0 ≤ degree := zero_le_one.trans hdegree
+  have hprefactor : 1 ≤ a * degree ^ a :=
+    one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le ha (Real.one_le_rpow hdegree ha0)
+  have hq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ P.q := Nat.cast_nonneg _
+  have htwo : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
+  have hroot_sum {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
+      (x + y + z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
+        x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
+    (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow (add_nonneg hx hy) hz (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).trans
+      (add_le_add (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow hx hy (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) le_rfl)
+  have hrate :
+      (epsilon ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * degree))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
+        epsilon ^ (b / 2) + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-(b / 2)) +
+          (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((b / 2) * degree)) := by
+    have h := hroot_sum (Real.rpow_nonneg hepsilon b) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq (-b))
+      (Real.rpow_nonneg htwo (-(b * degree)))
+    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hepsilon, ← Real.rpow_mul hq, ← Real.rpow_mul htwo] at h
+    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, neg_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h
+  unfold deltaQld
+  simp only [Real.rpow_eq_pow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
+  change (a * degree ^ a *
+      (epsilon ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * degree)))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ _
+  rw [Real.mul_rpow (zero_le_one.trans hprefactor) (by positivity)]
+  exact mul_le_mul
+    (Real.rpow_le_self_of_one_le hprefactor (by norm_num)) hrate
+    (by positivity) (zero_le_one.trans hprefactor)
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    30	private theorem exists_nonconstant_coeff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    31	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    32	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    33	  classical
    34	  by_contra! h
    35	  apply hp
    36	  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    37	  ext e
    38	  by_cases he : e = 0
    39	  · simp [he]
    40	  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he, h e he]

    43	outcome. Outside its zero set, every fiber has probability at most `D/q`;

    48	theorem exists_common_exceptional_coefficient {n k C D : ℕ}

    50	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    51	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    52	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 ∧

    54	        (fun z => if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    55	          (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F ∧
    56	      ∀ z : Fin k → F, MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : F,
    57	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    58	          (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    59	            then 1 else 0) ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
    60	  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := exists_nonconstant_coeff p hp
    61	  refine ⟨e, he, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    62	  · simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 hc (hcoeff e) (by simp)
    63	  · intro z hz b
    64	    have hne : MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p ≠ MvPolynomial.C b := by

    83	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
    84	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    85	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    86	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤ ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by

    89	    exists_common_exceptional_coefficient p hp hcoeff hdegree

    91	    rw [← hsum (fun _ => 0)]
    92	    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => hw _ b

    98	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by

   102	      · rw [← hsum z]

   104	        intro b _

   112	    · simp only [hz, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
   113	      rw [← hsum z, Finset.mul_sum]

   122	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad hM) le_rfl
   123	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   227	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   228	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ δL : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   229	        (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (_lines : ExtendedLinesWitness S points δL),

   231	        (directPassingErrorEnvelope (δQ + δL) ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q))
   232	        P.q (2 * P.m + 2) P.d 1
   233	      let eta := delta + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow delta (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   234	        2 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta)
   235	      Nonempty (GlobalPairWitness S (8 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   236	        (((12 * P.m * P.d + 4 * P.d + 14 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q))) := by
   237	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, h⟩ := exists_rounded_polynomial_separated_mass
   238	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, ?_⟩
   239	  intro P ε δQ δL S points lines delta eta
   240	  obtain ⟨RA, RB, hRA, hRB, horder, hmassA, hmassB⟩ := h P ε δQ δL S points lines
   241	  let pair₀ : PolyPair P := (0, 0)
   242	  have hA (reverse : Bool) := directPairMeasurement_consistency_le_ordered_error
   243	    S .AA' .BA'' (by trivial) RA hRA pair₀ reverse
   244	  have hB (reverse : Bool) := directPairMeasurement_consistency_le_ordered_error
   245	    S .BB' .AB'' (by trivial) RB hRB pair₀ reverse

   249	      8 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) + (((12 * P.m * P.d + 4 * P.d + 14 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) := by
   250	    push_cast
   251	    ring

   254	      | .alice => directPairMeasurement RA pair₀
   255	      | .bob => directPairMeasurement RB pair₀

   258	    point_consistent_bob := ?_ }⟩

   262	    · exact directPairMeasurement_projective RB hRB pair₀

   266	        (add_le_add hmassA (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (horder false).1 (by norm_num)))
   267	        le_rfl).trans_eq hbound)

   269	        (add_le_add hmassA (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (horder true).1 (by norm_num)))
   270	        le_rfl).trans_eq hbound)
   271	  · intro W
   272	    cases W
   273	    · exact (hB false).trans ((add_le_add
   274	        (add_le_add hmassB (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (horder false).2 (by norm_num)))
   275	        le_rfl).trans_eq hbound)
   276	    · exact (hB true).trans ((add_le_add
   277	        (add_le_add hmassB (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (horder true).2 (by norm_num)))
   278	        le_rfl).trans_eq hbound)

     5	# Transport of the polynomial-pair completion
     6	
     7	The actual singleton outcomes are transported by the canonical field
     8	equivalence before applying the algebraic completion.
     9	Every original outcome is retained, including those outside the combining image.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	Paper `eq:qld-sgg-completeness` and the completion paragraph of `lem:qld-4-7`,
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1375-1404`.
    15	-/

    26	private theorem map_mem_polyFunc {K L : Type*} [CommSemiring K] [CommSemiring L]
    27	    {n d : ℕ} (e : K →+* L) (p : Preliminaries.polyFunc n K d) :
    28	    MvPolynomial.map e p.1 ∈ Preliminaries.polyFunc n L d := by
    29	  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree]
    30	  intro s hs i
    31	  exact (MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree _ _ _).mp p.2 s
    32	    (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset e p.1 hs) i
    33	
    34	/-- Exact singleton and coefficient-field equivalence for the actual rounded
    35	outcomes. The degree certificates are transported through support inclusion. -/
    36	def directPolynomialEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    37	    DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd ≃
    38	      Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d where
    39	  toFun g := ⟨MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1,
    40	    map_mem_polyFunc _ _⟩
    41	  invFun p := fun _ => ⟨MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm.toRingHom p.1,
    42	    map_mem_polyFunc _ _⟩
    43	  left_inv g := by
    44	    funext i
    45	    have hi : i = (0 : Fin 1) := @Subsingleton.elim (Fin 1) _ i 0
    46	    subst i
    47	    apply Subtype.ext
    48	    exact (MvPolynomial.mapEquiv _ (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)).symm_apply_apply _
    49	  right_inv p := by
    50	    apply Subtype.ext
    51	    exact (MvPolynomial.mapEquiv _ (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)).apply_symm_apply _
    52	
    53	/-- The actual singleton outcome corresponding to a bounded polynomial pair. -/
    54	def directCombinedEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    55	    PolyPair P ↪ DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd :=
    56	  (combinedPolyEmbedding P).trans (directPolynomialEquiv P).symm.toEmbedding
    57	
    58	/-- Relabel the actual rounded measurement in the canonical coefficient field. -/
    59	def canonicalPolynomialMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    60	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι) :
    61	    Quantum.Measurement (Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) ι :=
    62	  R.postprocess (directPolynomialEquiv P)
    63	
    64	/-- The canonical relabeling retains each original effect exactly. -/
    65	@[simp] theorem canonicalPolynomialMeasurement_effect {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    66	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι)
    67	    (p : Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) :
    68	    (canonicalPolynomialMeasurement R).effect p =
    69	      R.effect ((directPolynomialEquiv P).symm p) := by
    70	  have h := SandwichProduct.postprocess_effect_of_injective R (directPolynomialEquiv P)
    71	    (directPolynomialEquiv P).injective ((directPolynomialEquiv P).symm p)
    72	  simpa only [canonicalPolynomialMeasurement, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h
    73	
    74	/-- The complete projective pair construction applied to the actual
    75	rounded measurement, including all excluded outcomes at one chosen pair. -/
    76	def directPairMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    77	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι)
    78	    (pair₀ : PolyPair P) : Quantum.Measurement (PolyPair P) ι :=
    79	  completedPairMeasurement P (canonicalPolynomialMeasurement R) pair₀
    80	
    81	/-- Projectivity follows from completion and injective field transport. -/
    82	theorem directPairMeasurement_projective {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    83	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι)
    84	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (pair₀ : PolyPair P) :
    85	    Measurement.IsProjective (directPairMeasurement R pair₀) :=
    86	  completedPairMeasurement_projective P _
    87	    (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective R hR _) pair₀
    88	
    89	/-- The faithful image predicate is exactly membership in the actual pair embedding. -/
    90	theorem mem_range_directCombinedEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams)
    91	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
    92	    g ∈ Set.range (directCombinedEmbedding P) ↔
    93	      ∃ pair : PolyPair P,
    94	        MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 =
    95	          combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1 := by
    96	  constructor
    97	  · rintro ⟨pair, rfl⟩
    98	    refine ⟨pair, ?_⟩
    99	    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((directPolynomialEquiv P).apply_symm_apply
   100	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair))
   101	  · rintro ⟨pair, hp⟩
   102	    refine ⟨pair, ?_⟩
   103	    apply (directPolynomialEquiv P).injective
   104	    exact ((directPolynomialEquiv P).apply_symm_apply _).trans (Subtype.ext hp.symm)
   105	
   106	/-- Evaluation of the actual retained outcome is the prescribed affine
   107	combination, with the original joint sample and canonical field transport. -/
   108	theorem directCombinedEmbedding_read (P : AdmissibleParams)
   109	    (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) (pair : PolyPair P) :
   110	    extendedPolynomialRead P x (directCombinedEmbedding P pair) =
   111	      x.2.1 * evalAt .X x.1.1 pair + x.2.2 * evalAt .Z x.1.2 pair := by
   112	  let u := (directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).symm x
   113	  have hx := directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv_apply P u
   114	  have heval : extendedPolynomialRead P x (directCombinedEmbedding P pair) =
   115	      MvPolynomial.eval (directPointToPauli P u) (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair).1 := by
   116	    let p : Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) P.d :=
   117	      directCombinedEmbedding P pair (0 : Fin 1)
   118	    have hp := congrArg Subtype.val ((directPolynomialEquiv P).apply_symm_apply
   119	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair))
   120	    change MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom p.1 = _ at hp
   121	    rw [← hp]
   122	    change extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (MvPolynomial.eval u p.1) = _
   123	    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_map]
   124	    exact (MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom u p.1).symm
   125	  rw [heval, combinedPolyEmbedding_eval]
   126	  have hx' : x = ((projX (directPointToPauli P u), projZ (directPointToPauli P u)),
   127	      (directPointToPauli P u (alphaVar P.m), directPointToPauli P u (betaVar P.m))) :=
   128	    ((directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).apply_symm_apply x).symm.trans hx
   129	  rw [hx']
   130	
   131	end

    41	private theorem placed_orderedIndicator {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

    61	      applyOperatorToState (S.place p2 T)
    62	        (applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 R) S.psiHat) =
    63	      applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 R * (1 - S.place p2 T)) S.psiHat := by

    95	        (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR) S.psiHat

    97	      (((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
    98	          ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
    99	        max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) /

   108	        intro g _

   359	/-- Consistency is symmetric for measurements on opposite registers. The
   360	operator commutation, rather than symmetry of the state or equality of local
   361	dimensions, justifies exchanging the placements in `lem:qld-xz-lines`. -/
   362	theorem consistencyDefect_opposite_symm {params : AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}
   363	    {Question Outcome : Type*} [Fintype Question] [DecidableEq Question]
   364	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
   365	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)
   366	    (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second) (distribution : Distribution Question)
   367	    (left : Question → Quantum.Measurement Outcome (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
   368	    (right : Question → Quantum.Measurement Outcome (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
   369	    consistencyDefect distribution
   370	      (fun question answer => setting.place first ((left question).effect answer))
   371	      (fun question answer => setting.place second ((right question).effect answer))
   372	      setting.psiHat =
   373	    consistencyDefect distribution
   374	      (fun question answer => setting.place second ((right question).effect answer))
   375	      (fun question answer => setting.place first ((left question).effect answer))
   376	      setting.psiHat := by
   377	  unfold consistencyDefect
   378	  congr 1
   379	  funext question
   380	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   381	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   382	  intro answer _
   383	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   384	  intro other _

   395	Claim 17-2 retain the source construction.

   397	The point-to-line comparisons and pasting argument at paper lines 900--961

   400	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_subline-claims-line-marginal.tex`; no equality or marginal
   401	assumption is added to a paper-facing theorem. -/
   402	theorem combined_line_measurement_consistency (deltaQ : ℝ → ℝ)
   403	    (hdeltaQ : IsPolyErr deltaQ) :
   404	    ∃ deltaP : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, IsPolyErr₂ deltaP ∧
   405	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   406	        (points : CombinedPointsWitness S (deltaQ ε))
   407	        (p1 p2 : Placement), p1.IsOpposite p2 →
   408	        consistencyDefect
   409	          (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
   410	            (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
   411	          (fun sample answer => S.place p1
   412	            (((S.combinedLineMeasurement p1.side sample.1.1 sample.2.1).postprocess
   413	              fun fs => (evalOpt sample.1.1 sample.1.2 fs.1,
   414	                evalOpt sample.2.1 sample.2.2 fs.2)).effect answer))
   415	          (fun sample answer => S.place p2
   416	            (((points.Q p2.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   417	              (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect answer))
   418	          S.psiHat ≤ deltaP ε (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)) := by
   419	  classical
   420	  obtain ⟨constant, hconstant, pastingError, hpasting, hrestored⟩ :=
   421	    exists_combinedLine_restored_defect_le
   422	  obtain ⟨lineError, hlineError, hscalar⟩ :=
   423	    exists_conditioned_polynomial_bound deltaQ hdeltaQ constant hconstant pastingError hpasting
   424	  refine ⟨lineError, hlineError, ?_⟩
   425	  intro params error setting points first second hopposite
   426	  have hreverse : second.IsOpposite first := by
   427	    cases first <;> cases second <;> trivial
   428	  rw [consistencyDefect_opposite_symm setting first second hopposite]
   429	  have hbound := hrestored params error (deltaQ error) setting points second first hreverse
   430	  have hcard : Fintype.card (ScalarQ params.toLdParams) = params.q :=
   431	    @FieldModel.card params.q params.model.toFieldModel
   432	  rw [hcard] at hbound
   433	  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < params.q := by
   434	    rw [← hcard]
   435	    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := ScalarQ params.toLdParams)
   436	  have hmd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (params.m * params.d : ℕ) := by
   437	    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ params.m * params.d by
   438	      simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul params.one_le_m params.hd)
   439	  have hdiscard : 1 / (2 * (params.q : ℝ)) ≤
   440	      (params.m * params.d : ℕ) / (params.q : ℝ) := by
   441	    calc
   442	      _ ≤ 1 / (params.q : ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hq (by linarith)

   445	      (Distribution.prod (linePointDist params.toLdParams) (linePointDist params.toLdParams))

   447	        (((points.Q second.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess
   448	          (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect answer))
   449	      (fun sample answer => setting.place first
   450	        (((setting.combinedLineMeasurement first.side sample.1.1 sample.2.1).postprocess
   451	          (fun polys => (evalOpt sample.1.1 sample.1.2 polys.1,
   452	            evalOpt sample.2.1 sample.2.2 polys.2))).effect answer)) setting.psiHat ≤ 1 := by
   453	    unfold consistencyDefect
   454	    calc
   455	      _ ≤ avgOver (Distribution.prod (linePointDist params.toLdParams)
   456	          (linePointDist params.toLdParams)) (fun _ => 1) :=

   458	          consistencyDefect_integrand_le_one setting second first hreverse _ _

   460	        (Distribution.prod_isProbability _ _ (linePointDist_isProbability params.toLdParams)

    27	/-- A positive atom gives a positive atom of every push-forward. -/
    28	private theorem map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos {Source Target : Type*}
    29	    [DecidableEq Target] (law : Distribution Source) (mapping : Source → Target)
    30	    (sample : Source) (hpositive : 0 < law.weight sample) :
    31	    0 < (law.map mapping).weight (mapping sample) := by
    32	  classical
    33	  have hmem : sample ∈ law.support := by
    34	    by_contra hnot
    35	    simp [law.outsideSupport sample hnot] at hpositive
    36	  exact hpositive.trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum
    37	    (fun other _ => law.nonnegative other) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, rfl⟩))

    39	/-- Every canonical direct line has positive marginal mass. In particular, the
    40	conditional distribution in the construction at paper lines 1118--1132 is defined
    41	on every direct line, including zero-direction diagonal lines. -/
    42	theorem directLinePointDist_line_weight_pos (params : DirectLdParams)
    43	    (line : DirectLineDesc params) :
    44	    0 < ((directLinePointDist params).map Prod.fst).weight line := by
    45	  have huniform (sample : DirectLdSpace params) :
    46	      0 < (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params)).weight sample := by
    47	    rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply]
    48	    positivity
    49	  suffices hpoint : 0 < (directLinePointDist params).weight (line, line.base) by
    50	    exact map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos _ Prod.fst _ hpoint
    51	  cases line with
    52	  | axis base index baseFixed =>
    53	    let sample : DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, 0⟩
    54	    have haxis := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
    55	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params))
    56	      (fun source => (directALineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    57	    have hdecode : directALineDescOf params sample = .axis base index baseFixed := by
    58	      simp [directALineDescOf, sample, baseFixed]
    59	    change 0 < (directALinePointDist params).weight _ at haxis
    60	    rw [hdecode] at haxis
    61	    have hother := (directDLinePointDist params).nonnegative
    62	      (DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base)
    63	    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
    64	      (1 - 1 / 2) * (directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    65	    change 0 < (directALinePointDist params).weight
    66	      (DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base) at haxis
    67	    dsimp only [DirectLineDesc.base]
    68	    linarith
    69	  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero =>
    70	    let sample : DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, direction⟩
    71	    have hprefix : directPrefixProjection index direction = direction := by
    72	      funext coordinate
    73	      simp only [directPrefixProjection]
    74	      split_ifs with hbefore
    75	      · exact (prefixZero coordinate hbefore).symm
    76	      · rfl
    77	    have hdiagonal := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
    78	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params))
    79	      (fun source => (directDLineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    80	    have hdecode : directDLineDescOf params sample =
    81	        .diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero := by
    82	      simp [directDLineDescOf, sample, hprefix, baseFixed]
    83	    change 0 < (directDLinePointDist params).weight _ at hdiagonal
    84	    rw [hdecode] at hdiagonal
    85	    have hother := (directALinePointDist params).nonnegative
    86	      (DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base)
    87	    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
    88	      (1 - 1 / 2) * (directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    89	    change 0 < (directDLinePointDist params).weight
    90	      (DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base) at hdiagonal
    91	    dsimp only [DirectLineDesc.base]

   201	      avgOver (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample => quantity sample.val)) =
   202	        avgOver sublines.D quantity := by
   203	  classical
   204	  simp only [avgOver, SubLineWitness.conditionalLaw]
   205	  calc
   206	    (∑ line ∈ (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).support,
   207	        (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line *
   208	          ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line,
   209	            (sublines.D.weight sample.val / (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line) *
   210	              quantity sample.val) =
   211	        ∑ line ∈ (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).support,
   212	          ∑ sample ∈ sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line),

   214	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

   217	      trans ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line, sublines.D.weight sample.val * quantity sample.val

   208	          ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line,

   212	          ∑ sample ∈ sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line),

1	# Mathematical Language Guidelines
     2	
     3	MIPStarRE Lean names and documentation should be written for readers comparing
     4	the formalization with the paper and blueprint.
     5	
     6	This is a project-local supplement to the Mathlib-derived documentation,
     7	naming, and style guides in the lean-conventions skill's `MATHLIB_doc`,
     8	`MATHLIB_naming`, and `MATHLIB_style` references.
     9	
    10	## Scope
    11	
    12	These guidelines apply to:
    13	
    14	- public Lean declaration names and namespace names;
    15	- module docstrings;
    16	- declaration docstrings;
    17	- documentation-visible section comments;
    18	- explanatory comments that describe the mathematical role of a declaration.
    19	- blueprint prose and formalization-support notes;
    20	- issue titles and issue bodies;
    21	- PR titles and PR descriptions.
    22	
    23	## Source of Truth
    24	
    25	Use terminology from the following sources, in this order:
    26	
    27	1. `references/ldt-paper/`
    28	2. `blueprint/src/chapter/`
    29	3. established local conventions in nearby Lean files
    30	
    31	When the paper has a term for the object, use that term. For Section 5, for
    32	example, prefer orthogonalization lemma, truncation function, rounding to
    33	projectors, rank reduction, and completing to measurement.
    34	
    35	## Reference Notation And Terminology
    36	
    37	The notation and terminology of the original reference are the default for
    38	reader-facing mathematical text.  A reader should be able to compare a Lean
    39	docstring, blueprint paragraph, issue, or PR description with the cited source
    40	without first learning a private vocabulary used by the formalization.
    41	
    42	When Lean must use a different name or representation, define the deviation in a
    43	location which future readers can find from the affected statement.  Use the
    44	first applicable location in the following order:
    45	
    46	1. the declaration docstring of the public object whose name or representation
    47	   differs from the paper;
    48	2. the module docstring of the defining Lean file, when the deviation concerns a
    49	   family of declarations in that file;
    50	3. the relevant blueprint paragraph, when the notation appears only in the
    51	   blueprint;
    52	4. a report under `docs/reports/` or `docs/paper-gaps/`, when the deviation is a
    53	   larger discrepancy between the paper, blueprint, and Lean.
    54	
    55	The explanation should say:
    56	
    57	- the notation or term used in the paper;
    58	- the Lean object or name which represents it;
    59	- the mathematical reason for the difference, if there is one;
    60	- the scope in which the replacement should be used.
    61	
    62	A PR description may mention the deviation, but it should not be the only place
    63	where future readers can learn it.
    64	
    65	Formalization-only auxiliary lemmas should be introduced as such.  Their prose
    66	should name the nearby paper equation, theorem, or construction they support,
    67	rather than presenting the auxiliary name as paper terminology.
    68	
    69	## Naming Norm
    70	
    71	Names and prose should describe the mathematical object, hypothesis, or
    72	conclusion. They should not encode the history of how the formalization was
    73	assembled.
    74	
    75	Avoid presenting words such as `pipeline`, `wrapper`, `package`, `raw`,
    76	`oneShot`, or `liveBlock` as mathematical terminology unless the cited source
    77	uses them with that meaning. Likewise, avoid implementation-local substitutes
    78	such as `projectivization` or `spectral truncation` when the paper gives a
    79	clearer phrase.
    80	
    81	This is a general rule for the repository, not only a rule for file splits.
    82	Module names, namespace names, public declarations, theorem fields, docstrings,
    83	blueprint-facing names, issue titles, and spec documents should name the
    84	mathematical layer under discussion, not the local workflow step, paper line
    85	number, or implementation history.
    86	
    87	### Concrete examples
    88	
    89	The table below illustrates the naming norm with examples patterned on the
    90	codebase and on names seen during review.  Some entries are existing names;
    91	others are proposed names for future refactors.  The "avoid" column lists
    92	process-shaped names that encode the history of how the formalization was
    93	assembled; the "prefer" column lists mathematical names that a reader of the
    94	paper or blueprint would recognize.
    95	
    96	| Avoid (process-shaped)                        | Prefer (mathematical)                     | Rationale                                              |
    97	|:----------------------------------------------|:------------------------------------------|:-------------------------------------------------------|
    98	| `Line130`                                     | `ProjectiveConsistency`                   | Paper Lemma 5.13, not "the line-130 identity"          |
    99	| `Line169`                                     | `CompletionTransport`                     | Paper Lemma 5.16, step that transports completed data  |
   100	| `Step6`                                       | `Orthonormalization`                      | Paper Section 5, the orthonormalization construction   |
   101	| `FinalAssembly`                               | `DiagonalCompletion`                      | Paper Lemma 5.17, constructing a diagonal POVM         |
   102	| `OneShotIneq`                                 | `SelfConsistencyDataProcessing` (or existing module `Preliminaries.SelfConsistency.DataProcessing`)           | Paper's data-processing inequality for self-consistency |
   103	| `PipelineCheck`                               | `ErrorPropagationBound` (proposed)                   | The bound that propagates error through the test       |
   104	| `QxpLayerWrapper`                             | `ProjectivePOVMCompletion` (proposed)                | The construction from round-projectors to POVMs        |
   105	| `RawSpectralTruncation`                       | `SpectralTruncation`                      | The paper's spectral truncation, not an "unwrapped" version |
   106	| `AddInUStep3To5`                              | `AddInUUpperExcessMass` (proposed)                  | Paper Addendum in §U, the upper excess-mass estimate   |
   107	| `AddInUStep12`                                | `AddInUCommutationTail` (proposed)                   | Paper Addendum in §U, the commutation tail estimate    |
   108	
   109	An avoided name is acceptable only when the cited paper itself uses that
   110	phrase as the mathematical name (e.g., a lemma the paper calls "Step 2").
   111	In that case the docstring should cite the paper's phrasing.
   112	
   113	File-split PRs are a common place where this rule matters: new leaves should be
   114	named by the mathematical boundary they isolate, and any public declarations
   115	exposed by the split should be reviewed under the same standard.
   116	
   117	### Shared helpers
   118	
   119	When the same (or nearly the same) helper declaration appears in two or
   120	more chapter-local leaves, the copies should be consolidated into a single
   121	shared helper in an appropriate common module.  This avoids duplication and
   122	ensures that fixes, generalizations, or upstream replacements apply to all
   123	call sites at once.  Issue [#1145] tracks this work across the repository.
   124	
   125	Procedure:
   126	
   127	1. **Confirm equivalence.**  Compare the statement of each copy.  If the
   128	   types differ only by a chapter-specific parameterization (e.g.,
   129	   `SubMeas (Polynomial params) ι` vs `SubMeas (Point params) ι`),
   130	   parameterize the shared helper over that type via a `variable` or
   131	   explicit argument.
   132	2. **Find the right home.**  Prefer a module that is already imported by
   133	   both call sites.  Typical candidates:
   134	   - `MIPStarRE/LDT/Basic/` for parameter-free operators and bounds,
   135	   - `MIPStarRE/LDT/Preliminaries/` for polynomial/field/character lemmas,
   136	   - The highest chapter that is a common dependency of the two sites.
   137	3. **Name mathematically.**  Give the shared helper a name that describes
   138	   what it states, not which chapter it originally came from.
   139	4. **Replace call sites.**  Delete the chapter-local copies and replace
   140	   their uses with the shared helper.  A thin wrapper is allowed only when it
   141	   preserves a paper-facing or blueprint-facing name that external readers
   142	   need to search for; such wrappers should have a docstring or compatibility
   143	   comment explaining why the alias exists.  Remove the wrapper once that
   144	   paper-facing name is no longer needed for external reference.
   145	5. **Document.**  Add a docstring to the shared helper citing the paper or
   146	   blueprint location it supports.
   147	
   148	### Legacy identifier treatment
   149	
   150	If a docstring must mention a legacy Lean identifier, cite it in backticks and
   151	describe the mathematical object in paper terminology. If an old public
   152	identifier cannot be renamed in the current PR, record the required migration
   153	in the issue, PR description, or an audit file under `audits/`.
   154	
   155	Do not add an empty pass-through abbreviation merely to introduce a second
   156	public name.  This is different from a documented public wrapper allowed in the
   157	shared-helper procedure above: a wrapper must preserve a paper-facing or
   158	blueprint-facing term and must say why the alias exists.
   159	
   160	## Review Checklist
   161	
   162	Reviewers should use this checklist when examining public names and
   163	documentation prose.  Flag any item that fails.
   164	
   165	- [ ] **Naming.**  Do public declaration names, namespace names, module names,

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.DirectPassingErrorBounds
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.RootErrorBounds
+
+/-! # Absorption of the actual rounded polynomial-pair error
+
+The point and line errors both enter low-degree soundness. The actual
+projective rounding then incurs an eighth root. The unit cap is applied only
+to the final consistency defect.
+
+## References
+
+Paper `lem:qld-4-7`,
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1404`.
+This module composes the direct passing estimate with square-root closure for
+the global error function.
+-/
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+/-- On the unit interval, all actual rounding terms are bounded by an eighth
+root. The point error is controlled through its square root, as in the saved
+direct passing bound. The cap uses the independent unit bound on defects. -/
+theorem actual_rounding_error_le_root {delta point ratio t : ℝ}
+    (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (hp : 0 ≤ point)
+    (hdt : delta ≤ t) (hpt : Real.sqrt point ≤ t) (hrt : ratio ≤ t) :
+    min 1 (32 * delta + 32 * Real.sqrt (220 * delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
+      64 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta) + 64 * point + 30 * ratio) ≤
+      1024 * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (min 1 t))) := by
+  have ht : 0 ≤ t := hd.trans hdt
+  by_cases ht1 : t ≤ 1
+  · rw [min_eq_right ht1]
+    have hroot : Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt t)) = t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
+      simp only [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
+      rw [← Real.rpow_mul ht, ← Real.rpow_mul ht]
+      norm_num
+    rw [hroot]
+    have h18 : t ≤ t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
+      simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' ht ht1
+        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8) (by norm_num : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
+    have h14 : t ≤ t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
+      simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' ht ht1
+        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4) (by norm_num : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
+    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
+      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul ht]
+      norm_num
+    have hround : Real.sqrt (220 * delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤
+        15 * t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
+      calc
+        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (225 * t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
+          (mul_le_mul (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_le_rpow hd hdt (by norm_num))
+            (Real.rpow_nonneg hd _) (by norm_num))
+        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), hsqrt]; norm_num
+    have hsecond : Real.sqrt (2 * delta) ≤ 2 * t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
+      calc
+        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (4 * t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
+          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [Real.rpow_nonneg ht (1 / 4 : ℝ)])
+        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), hsqrt]; norm_num
+    have hpoint : point ≤ t := by
+      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hp, Real.sqrt_nonneg point]
+    refine (min_le_right _ _).trans ?_
+    nlinarith [Real.rpow_nonneg ht (1 / 8 : ℝ)]
+  · rw [min_eq_left (le_of_not_ge ht1)]
+    norm_num
+
+/-- A fixed positive coefficient can be absorbed by increasing the universal
+prefactor exponent, for every nonnegative strategy error. -/
+theorem scale_deltaQld_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {a b epsilon K : ℝ}
+    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (he : 0 ≤ epsilon) (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
+    K * deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q ≤
+      deltaQld (K * a) b epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+  have hmd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
+    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)
+  have haK : a ≤ K * a := le_mul_of_one_le_left (by linarith) hK
+  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by linarith
+  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by linarith
+  have hsum : 0 ≤ Real.rpow epsilon b + Real.rpow (P.q : ℝ) (-b) +
+      Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
+    add_nonneg (add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg he _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _))
+      (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
+  unfold deltaQld
+  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
+  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
+      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hmd haK) (mul_nonneg hK0 ha0)) hsum
+
+/-- Universal absorption of the actual rounded pair error, including the
+point and line errors in the passing envelope and the eighth-root rounding
+loss. The constants precede all admissible parameters and nonnegative errors.
+This is the final scalar substitution for paper `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
+theorem exists_actual_rounded_global_pair_error_bound (pointError : ℝ → ℝ)
+    (hpoint : IsPolyErr pointError) (lineError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
+    (hline : IsPolyErr₂ lineError) (C a b : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
+    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) :
+    ∃ A B : ℝ, 1 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧ B < 1 ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ), 0 ≤ epsilon →
+        let delta := deltaLd a b
+          (directPassingErrorEnvelope
+            (pointError epsilon + C * (P.m : ℝ) *
+              lineError epsilon ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) / (P.q : ℝ)))
+            ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) / (P.q : ℝ))) P.q (2 * P.m + 2) P.d 1
+        let eta := delta + Real.sqrt (220 * delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
+          2 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta)
+        min 1 (8 * (4 * eta + 8 * pointError epsilon) +
+          (((12 * P.m * P.d + 4 * P.d + 14 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q)) ≤
+          deltaQld A B epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hB1, hbound⟩ :=
+    exists_direct_global_pair_error_bound pointError hpoint lineError hline
+      C a b 1 hC ha hb hb1 (by norm_num)
+  refine ⟨1024 * A, B / 2 / 2 / 2, by linarith, by positivity, by linarith, ?_⟩
+  intro P epsilon he delta eta
+  let ratio : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q
+  let passing := directPassingErrorEnvelope
+    (pointError epsilon + C * (P.m : ℝ) * lineError epsilon ratio) ratio
+  let slack := deltaLd a b (passing + epsilon) P.q (2 * P.m + 2) P.d 1
+  let t := slack + Real.sqrt (pointError epsilon) + ratio
+  have hr : 0 ≤ ratio := by dsimp [ratio]; positivity
+  have hpass : 0 ≤ passing := by dsimp [passing, directPassingErrorEnvelope]; positivity
+  have hp : 0 ≤ pointError epsilon := by
+    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, h⟩ := hpoint
+    exact (h epsilon he).1
+  have hs : 0 ≤ slack := by dsimp [slack, deltaLd]; positivity
+  have hd : 0 ≤ delta := by dsimp [delta, deltaLd, directPassingErrorEnvelope]; positivity
+  have hds : delta ≤ slack := by
+    change deltaLd a b passing P.q (2 * P.m + 2) P.d 1 ≤ _
+    dsimp [slack, deltaLd]
+    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
+    exact add_le_add (add_le_add
+      (Real.rpow_le_rpow hpass (by linarith) hb.le) le_rfl) le_rfl
+  have hdt : delta ≤ t := by dsimp [t]; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (pointError epsilon)]
+  have hpt : Real.sqrt (pointError epsilon) ≤ t := by dsimp [t]; linarith
+  have hrt : ratio ≤ t := by dsimp [t]; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (pointError epsilon)]
+  have hratio : (((12 * P.m * P.d + 4 * P.d + 14 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) ≤ 30 * ratio := by
+    have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ P.m := by exact_mod_cast P.one_le_m
+    have hd' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ P.d := by exact_mod_cast P.hd
+    dsimp [ratio]
+    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
+    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
+    push_cast
+    nlinarith
+  have hcap : min 1 t ≤ deltaQld A B epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+    simpa only [one_mul] using hbound P epsilon he
+  have hroot := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hcap))
+  have hrootBound := (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
+    (sqrt_deltaQld_le (P := P) hA.le he))).trans
+      ((Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (sqrt_deltaQld_le (P := P) (b := B / 2) hA.le he)).trans
+        (sqrt_deltaQld_le (P := P) (b := B / 2 / 2) hA.le he))
+  refine (min_le_min_left 1 ?_).trans
+    ((actual_rounding_error_le_root hd hp hdt hpt hrt).trans
+      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hroot.trans hrootBound) (by norm_num)).trans
+        (scale_deltaQld_le hA.le he (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1024))))
+  dsimp [eta]
+  linarith
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.SoundnessDefs
+
+/-!
+# Square roots of the Pauli soundness error
+
+The state-extraction estimate bounds a squared norm. Taking its square root
+preserves the Pauli soundness error family after halving the exponent.
+
+## References
+
+Recovered from the verified issue #529 object at
+`a7a52e4c0d7bad95d471036accedd33b358694fb`,
+`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Soundness/ErrorBounds.lean`, for issue #513.
+
+Blueprint `rem:pauli-robustness-form`; the source states the squared bound at
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1868-1876`,
+whereas `thm:pauli` bounds the unsquared norm.
+-/
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+/-- Taking the square root of the Pauli error is bounded by halving its
+exponent. This formalization-only scalar estimate supports the passage from
+the squared extraction bound to the norm bound in blueprint
+`rem:pauli-robustness-form`; it is stated as `thm:pauli-error-square-root-support`.
+It holds for all nonnegative errors. -/
+theorem sqrt_deltaQld_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {a b epsilon : ℝ}
+    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) :
+    Real.sqrt (deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ≤
+      deltaQld a (b / 2) epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+  let degree : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ)
+  have hdegree : 1 ≤ degree :=
+    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)
+  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := zero_le_one.trans ha
+  have hdegree0 : 0 ≤ degree := zero_le_one.trans hdegree
+  have hprefactor : 1 ≤ a * degree ^ a :=
+    one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le ha (Real.one_le_rpow hdegree ha0)
+  have hq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ P.q := Nat.cast_nonneg _
+  have htwo : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
+  have hroot_sum {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
+      (x + y + z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
+        x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
+    (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow (add_nonneg hx hy) hz (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).trans
+      (add_le_add (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow hx hy (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) le_rfl)
+  have hrate :
+      (epsilon ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * degree))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
+        epsilon ^ (b / 2) + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-(b / 2)) +
+          (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((b / 2) * degree)) := by
+    have h := hroot_sum (Real.rpow_nonneg hepsilon b) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq (-b))
+      (Real.rpow_nonneg htwo (-(b * degree)))
+    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hepsilon, ← Real.rpow_mul hq, ← Real.rpow_mul htwo] at h
+    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, neg_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h
+  unfold deltaQld
+  simp only [Real.rpow_eq_pow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
+  change (a * degree ^ a *
+      (epsilon ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * degree)))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ _
+  rw [Real.mul_rpow (zero_le_one.trans hprefactor) (by positivity)]
+  exact mul_le_mul
+    (Real.rpow_le_self_of_one_le hprefactor (by norm_num)) hrate
+    (by positivity) (zero_le_one.trans hprefactor)
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     4	/-!
     5	# Direct low-degree soundness for arbitrary strategies
     6	
     7	This module transports directly indexed low-degree soundness at simultaneity
     8	parameter `1` from projective strategies to arbitrary strategies. Both local
     9	measurement families are dilated by the existing one-measurement Naimark
    10	construction. The polynomial-tuple POVMs returned by projective soundness are
    11	then compressed to the original player carriers at the distinguished ancillary
    12	coordinate.
    13	
    14	Ground-slice compression preserves all three consistency defects exactly, so
    15	the error function and its universal constants are unchanged. The compressed
    16	polynomial POVMs are not asserted to be projective.
    17	
    18	## Main result
    19	
    20	* `exists_direct_ld_soundness_of_k_eq_one_any_strategy` removes the projectivity
    21	  premise from the formalization-only direct `k = 1` soundness route.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	The projective soundness input formalizes the shape of paper
    26	`lem:ld-soundness`,
    27	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`.
    28	The Naimark transport supports the first paragraph of the proof of paper
    29	`lem:qld-4-7`,
    30	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1277-1289`.
    31	This module is Lean-only support and does not claim completion of that lemma.
    32	-/

   431	requires deriving that correlation from the source measurements; no such
   432	estimate is an input to this auxiliary theorem. -/
   433	theorem nonlinear_mass_le_ordered_error {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type*}
   434	    (s : Finset Γ) (p : Γ → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   435	    (hp : ∀ g ∈ s, ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   436	      p g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   437	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   438	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   439	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   440	    ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   441	      2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   442	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s,
   443	          ‖ψ g - applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   444	            (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)‖ ^ 2)) +
   445	      2 * ∑ g ∈ s,
   446	        (((p g).support.sup fun e => ((p g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   447	          max 1 (p g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by
   448	  let A (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) (g : Γ) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι :=
   449	    applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   450	      (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)
   451	  have hpoint (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   452	      ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   453	        2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2 :=
   454	    sum_mass_le_residual_add_image s ψ (A u v)
   455	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) _ _ fun u =>
   456	    avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (hpoint u)
   457	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at havg
   458	  have hnorm := avg_sum_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear s p hp X Z hX hZ ψ
   459	  change ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   460	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   461	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2)) + _
   462	  change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   463	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   464	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2)) ≤ _ at hnorm
   465	  linarith

    26	private theorem place_add {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    27	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
    28	    (A B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
    29	    S.place p (A + B) = S.place p A + S.place p B := by
